rows.note: Use this for an unenviable task, situation, or responsibility that is troublesome or undesirable; it is the all-purpose choice here.

example.english: Having to submit this report tonight is an unenviable task.
example.traditional: 呢份報告要今晚交，真係麻煩。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 gam1 maan1 gaau1 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Use this when the situation is especially difficult or unpleasant to endure, rather than merely troublesome.

example.english: Spending the whole night waiting in the emergency room was unenviable.
example.traditional: 坐喺急症室等咗成晚，真係難捱。
example.jyutping: zo6 hai2 gap1 zing3 sat1 dang2 zo2 seng4 maan5 zan1 hai6 naan4 ngaai4

rows.note: Use this when stressing the literal sense that the situation or advantage is not something anyone should envy.

example.traditional: 佢份工人工高，但日日做到凌晨，真係唔值得羨慕。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 gou1 daan6 jat6 jat6 zou6 dou3 ling4 san4 zan1 hai6 m4 zik6 dak1 sin6 mou6
